explanation: John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich, is said to have asked for meat between slices of bread so he could eat without stopping work. His title comes from Sandwich, a town in Kent.

claims.text: The sandwich is named after John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich, who lived from 1718 to 1792.
The man the sandwich is named after was an earl, not a duke, a bishop or a prince.
According to a popular story, the Earl asked for meat between bread so that he could eat without interrupting what he was doing.
The earldom of Sandwich takes its name from Sandwich, a town in Kent, England.
